entries.title: Numbers 28:1
segments: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

entries.title: Numbers 28:2
segments: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, My offering, my bread for my offerings by fire of sweet odour to me, shall ye take heed to present to me at their set time.

entries.title: Numbers 28:3
segments: And say unto them, This is the offering by fire which ye shall present to Jehovah: two yearling lambs without blemish, day by day, as a continual burnt-offering.

entries.title: Numbers 28:4
segments: The one lamb shalt thou offer in the morning, and the other lamb thou shalt offer between the two evenings;

entries.title: Numbers 28:5
segments: and a tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for an oblation, mingled with beaten oil, a fourth part of a hin:

entries.title: Numbers 28:6
segments: [it is] the continual burnt-offering which was ordained on mount Sinai for a sweet odour, an offering by fire to Jehovah.

entries.title: Numbers 28:7
segments: And the drink-offering thereof shall be a fourth part of a hin for one lamb; in the sanctuary shall the drink-offering of strong drink be poured out to Jehovah.

entries.title: Numbers 28:8
segments: And the second lamb thou shalt offer between the two evenings; [with the] like oblation as that of the morning, and the like drink-offering, shalt thou offer it as an offering by fire of a sweet odour to Jehovah.

entries.title: Numbers 28:9
segments: ¶And on the sabbath day two yearling lambs without blemish, and two tenth parts of fine flour as an oblation, mingled with oil, and the drink-offering thereof:

entries.title: Numbers 28:10
segments: it is the burnt-offering of the sabbath, for each sabbath besides the continual burnt-offering, and its drink-offering.

entries.title: Numbers 28:11
segments: And in the beginnings of your months ye shall present a burnt-offering to Jehovah: two young bullocks, and one ram, seven yearling lambs without blemish.

entries.title: Numbers 28:12
segments: And three tenth parts of fine flour as an oblation, mingled with oil, for one bullock; and two tenth parts of fine flour as an oblation, mingled with oil, for the ram;

entries.title: Numbers 28:13
segments: and a tenth part of fine flour mingled with oil as an oblation for each lamb: [it is] a burnt-offering of a sweet odour, an offering by fire to Jehovah.

entries.title: Numbers 28:14
segments: And their drink-offerings: half a hin of wine for a bullock, and the third part of a hin for the ram, and the fourth part of a hin for a lamb. This is the monthly burnt-offering for each month throughout the months of the year.

entries.title: Numbers 28:15
segments: And a buck of the goats shall be offered, for a sin-offering to Jehovah, besides the continual burnt-offering, and its drink-offering.

entries.title: Numbers 28:16
segments: ¶And in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is the passover to Jehovah.

entries.title: Numbers 28:17
segments: And on the fifteenth day of this month is the feast; seven days shall unleavened bread be eaten.

entries.title: Numbers 28:18
segments: On the first day shall be a holy convocation: no manner of servile work shall ye do;

entries.title: Numbers 28:19
segments: and ye shall present an offering by fire, a burnt-offering to Jehovah: two young bullocks, and one ram, and seven yearling lambs; they shall be unto you without blemish;

entries.title: Numbers 28:20
segments: and their oblation shall be of fine flour mingled with oil: three tenth parts shall ye offer for a bullock, and two tenth parts for the ram;

entries.title: Numbers 28:21
segments: one tenth part shalt thou offer for each lamb, of the seven lambs;

entries.title: Numbers 28:22
segments: and a he-goat as a sin-offering, to make atonement for you.

entries.title: Numbers 28:23
segments: Besides the burnt-offering of the morning, which is for a continual burnt-offering, shall ye offer this.

entries.title: Numbers 28:24
segments: After this manner ye shall offer daily, seven days, the bread of the offering by fire of a sweet odour to Jehovah; it shall be offered besides the continual burnt-offering, and its drink-offering.

entries.title: Numbers 28:25
segments: And on the seventh day ye shall have a holy convocation; no manner of servile work shall ye do.

entries.title: Numbers 28:26
segments: And on the day of the first-fruits, when ye present a new oblation to Jehovah, after your weeks, ye shall have a holy convocation: no manner of servile work shall ye do.

entries.title: Numbers 28:27
segments: And ye shall present a burnt-offering for a sweet odour to Jehovah: two young bullocks, one ram, seven yearling lambs;

entries.title: Numbers 28:28
segments: and their oblation of fine flour mingled with oil, three tenth parts for one bullock, two tenth parts for the ram,

entries.title: Numbers 28:29
segments: one tenth part for each lamb of the seven lambs;

entries.title: Numbers 28:30
segments: [and] one buck of the goats, to make atonement for you.

entries.title: Numbers 28:31
segments: Ye shall offer them besides the continual burnt-offering, and its oblation (without blemish shall they be unto you), and their drink-offerings.
